q: Do you publish edited series without permission?

q: How should RAW files be delivered (format and platform)?

q: Can revisions be made to edited images?
a: Yes. All preferences and adjustments that align with the agreed brief are included in the price. A new request that wasn’t part of the original agreement is billed separately. If a revision concerns something that was in the brief or references but wasn’t implemented on my side, it is corrected free of charge.

Payment is made after the color and editing direction are approved. You decide to move forward only after you’ve seen a sample result and are confident it fits your expectations. Once approved, full payment is made, and only then do I edit the entire order.

q: Do you work without references or a brief?
a: I don’t work in a “just make it look nice” format. Even a minimal reference or a short brief helps achieve the desired result faster and more accurately, saving you a lot of time. If you don’t yet have a defined style, we can shape it together, but never blindly.
